code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, monocytosis, and elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, and basophils. There is also low total CO₂, suggesting possible metabolic acidosis. These findings may indicate acute or chronic hypoxic and inflammatory processes, with possible infection or hematologic disorder. No significant renal or hepatic dysfunction is evident. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
